spells.name: Seastone Trident
spells.description: Passive: Fizz's Attacks cause his enemies to bleed, dealing magic damage over seconds. Active: Fizz's next Attack deals an additional magic damage. If this Attack kills its target, Fizz refunds Mana and reduces the cooldown of this Ability to second. If it does not kill, Fizz's Attacks deal an additional magic damage for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: Seastone Trident applies a refreshable six-tick bleed, arms the next attack for four seconds, and empowers later attacks for five seconds after the armed hit. Kill-only mana and cooldown behavior is outside the supported same-target continuation.

effects.label: Seastone Trident Bleed
effects.description: Each successful basic attack applies six magic-damage ticks over three seconds. A later hit refreshes and replaces the remaining ticks.

effects.label: Seastone Trident Active Attack
effects.description: Casting W arms the next successful basic attack within four seconds for bonus magic damage.

effects.label: Seastone Trident Follow-Up On-Hit
effects.description: After the armed attack, later attacks add magic damage for five seconds.

validationNotes: Reviewed against pinned CommunityDragon champion detail and BIN sources for patch 16.16.

components.label: Seastone Trident Bleed
components.description: Basic attacks apply six half-second magic-damage ticks over three seconds. Reapplication refreshes the effect and replaces ticks that have not resolved.
components.reason: Compiled as refreshable source-target scheduled damage.

components.label: Seastone Trident Active Attack
components.description: Casting W arms one successful basic attack for four seconds. The attack consumes the armed state and adds patch-ranked magic damage.
components.reason: Compiled as participant state and a consuming damage operation.

components.label: Seastone Trident Follow-Up On-Hit
components.description: After the armed attack, later successful attacks add patch-ranked magic damage for five seconds.
components.reason: Compiled as a timed participant state.

components.label: Kill Refund
components.description: If the armed attack kills, W refunds mana, sets its cooldown to one second, and does not grant the follow-up buff.
components.reason: Mana and target-death continuation do not change the supported damage result. Simulation stops on lethal damage unless the sandbox override is enabled.

components.label: Basic Attack Reset
components.description: Casting W resets Fizz's basic-attack timer.

spells.name: Playful / Trickster
spells.description: Fizz hops onto his trident, becoming Untargetable for 0.75 seconds, after which he deals magic damage to nearby enemies and Slows them by % for seconds. Fizz can Recast this Ability while Untargetable to dash again, which ends the effect early, deals damage in a smaller area, and doesn't Slow.

spells.name: Chum the Waters
spells.description: Fizz launches a fish that attaches to the first champion hit. The victim is afflicted with True Sight and Slowed by between 40% to 80% based on how far the fish travelled before attaching. After seconds a shark erupts on the target, Knocking Up the target with the fish for 1 second, Knocking Back everything else, and dealing between to magic damage based on how far the fish travelled before attaching.
